name: sq80-fm1
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
tagline: an Ensoniq SQ-80 voice engine test for the FM-1
description: A test firmware: the sq80-fm1 engine (an Ensoniq SQ-80 voice: three wavetable oscillators, a 4-pole filter, four envelopes, three LFOs, 8 voices) playing four test sounds on built-in synthetic waves, with the audio CPU load on screen.
